findings.rationale: The policy statement allows Action "*": every action in the account is grantable through this policy, so any holder can escalate beyond any intended boundary.
The statement applies to Resource "*": the grant is not contained to any resource boundary, so action scope aside, no scoping defense remains.

Cross-fixture reasoning: combined with the public-read ACL planted in tf_s3_public_access, an identity holding this policy can read every object in that bucket. Neither finding alone shows the chain; the audit must.
